prerequisites.evidence: Prerequisite for CSC 642: CSC 413 with a grade of C or better or consent of the instructor.

other_requirements.evidence: Prerequisite for CSC 642: CSC 413 with a grade of C or better or consent of the instructor.
Prerequisite for CSC 642: CSC 413 with a grade of C or better or consent of the instructor.

learning_outcomes: Understand the basics of the field of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
Understand and apply design principles to a system, component, or process from a user-centered perspective.
Apply user-centered design and research methods to conduct user studies and evaluate a product.
Develop and iterate upon user-centered design-based solutions to real-world technological problems.
Understand and be able to apply industry standard methods for evaluation of usability.
Complete a semester long design project in small team setting; write a report and present it, as well as provide constructive peer feedback.
topics: Identifying and Defining a User Problem
Research Methods: Participatory Design, User Personas, User Tasks, Storyboards
Surveys, Longitudinal Methods, and Data Analysis Approaches
HCI Applications: Emerging Topics in HCI Communities

skills.evidence: Apply user-centered design and research methods to conduct user studies and evaluate a product.

skills.skill: Research methods (Interviews, Focus Groups, Card Sorting, Participatory Design, Surveys, Longitudinal Methods, Data Analysis)
skills.evidence: Research Methods: Interviews/Focus Groups/Card Sorting; Research Methods: Participatory Design, User Personas, User Tasks, Storyboards; Surveys, Longitudinal Methods, and Data Analysis Approaches
High-fidelity prototype using Figma or a design tool of your choice
Conduct usability testing of your prototype and incorporate feedback
Understand and be able to apply industry standard methods for evaluation of usability.
